newsitem.title: USA: Supervalu says cost cuts helped boost net.
newsitem.headline: Supervalu says cost cuts helped boost net.

text.p: Supervalu Inc said Thursday cost controls and improved margins helped net income climb to $40 million from $38 million in the third quarter.

The company said overall sales were flat compared with year-ago results at $3.9 billion. The most recent figure was affected by the expected loss of a major customer in the southeast and the continuing impact from the 1995 closing of a major customer in the northeast, said Supervalu.
Supervalu operates a food distribution operation in addition to a food store chain.
The company's stock was down 1/8 at 28-5/8.
